sections.text_helper: Section 49.8.18 "CRYP initialization vector register 0R (CRYP_IV0RR)" in chapter 49 (Cryptographic processor (CRYP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2404.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x44
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 IVI[95:64]: Initialization vector bit x (x= 95 to 64)
This bitfield stores the initialization vector bits [95:64] for AES chaining modes other than
ECB.
The value stored in CRYP_IVxR/LR registers is updated by hardware after each computation
round (when applicable).
Write to this register is ignored when CRYP is busy (BUSY bit set).
